metadata.purpose: Acceptance cases for Meeting 02 recommendation grounding
metadata.baseline_note: Historical fixture review retained for comparison with the integrated pipeline.

live_evaluation.summary: All five requests returned success with exactly three looks and only known source IDs. The Nhat Binh case remains a warning because two looks did not explicitly restate the defining rectangular opposing collar.

input.description: Áo dài dự lễ hội, thanh lịch và có chi tiết hiện đại vừa phải.

assertions: Cultural note must distinguish historical context from contemporary variation.
Output must not claim one collar, sleeve or decoration is mandatory for every ao dai.

baseline_review.reason: Fixture returns ao_ngu_than for all looks and cites SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER, so it neither follows the requested garment nor grounds the note in an existing source.

live_review.reason: All looks keep the requested garment, cite the approved museum source and frame collar, sleeve and decoration as historically variable rather than universal.

input.description: Tham quan di tích, ưu tiên áo ngũ thân tay chẽn gọn gàng.

assertions: Claims about five buttons and narrow sleeves must be limited to the tay chen variant described by the source.
Color or motif from one artifact must not be presented as universal.

baseline_review.reason: Fixture matches the garment label but provides only a generic unreviewed note and the nonexistent SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER citation.

live_review.reason: All looks stay within the tay chen variant described by the source and avoid presenting one artifact palette or motif as universal.

input.description: Bản phối áo tứ thân theo bối cảnh lễ hội Kinh Bắc.

assertions: Structure must be described as four fabric panels/tails, without borrowing the joined-back detail of the inner ao canh.
The black skirt, white yem and mo qua scarf ensemble must be labeled as a specific reconstructed festival context, not a universal requirement.

baseline_review.reason: Fixture ignores the requested ao_tu_than garment and has no valid source for either structure or festival context.

live_review.reason: The output describes the four-panel structure correctly and scopes the skirt, yem and mo qua ensemble to the reconstructed Kinh Bac festival context.

input.description: Chụp ảnh với Nhật Bình lấy cảm hứng đương đại, không giả định phẩm cấp cung đình.

assertions: The look must retain or explicitly discuss the rectangular opposing collar when calling itself Nhat Binh.
Motifs and yellow color from Empress Dowager Doan Huy's artifact must not be generalized to every Nhat Binh or rank.

baseline_review.reason: Fixture ignores the requested nhat_binh garment and cites no valid source for structure, court context or contemporary variation.

live_review.reason: All citations are valid and the output avoids inferring court rank, but two looks do not explicitly retain or discuss the defining rectangular opposing collar. Owner Lan Anh will make the Cultural Critic enforce or flag this record in Meeting 03; Linh will review the resulting severity and fix.

input.description: Đi chúc Tết gia đình, cần trang trọng vừa phải và giải thích rõ lý do chọn loại Việt phục.

assertions: Each selected garment must cite only records and sources linked to that garment.
The recommendation must explain the garment choice without inventing a universal Tet rule.
All returned source IDs must exist in references.json.

baseline_review.reason: Fixture always selects ao_ngu_than without explaining auto selection and all three looks cite SOURCE_PLACEHOLDER, which is absent from references.json.

live_review.reason: The three looks explain different garment choices for the Tet request and every citation belongs to the selected garment; no universal Tet rule is invented.
